run_pybullet_quadruped_demo: run the pybullet quadruped URDF demo with interactive roll, pitch, yaw, and position sliders
connect_pybullet_client: connect to a pybullet simulation client using shared memory or GUI mode
load_urdf_model: load a quadruped URDF model into the pybullet simulation with a fixed base
create_debug_sliders: create user debug parameter sliders for roll, pitch, yaw, and x, y, z position
reset_base_pose: reset the base position and orientation of a body using euler angles and xyz coordinates
